主要内容: The document titled 's1101316k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, published on January 11, 2013. This filing is part of the Bank's compliance with U.S. securities regulations and includes information about the issuance of $2.25 billion in Floating Rate Senior Notes, due January 6, 2015. The filing includes various legal opinions and consents from law firms such as Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Canada LLP. The report is incorporated by reference into the Bank's Registration Statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The filing is signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada.
